shortDescription: Allows administration of Keycloak client authorization scopes using Keycloak API

options.name: auth_client_id
options.description: OpenID Connect I(client_id) to authenticate to the API with.

options.name: auth_client_secret
options.description: Client Secret to use in conjunction with I(auth_client_id) (if required).

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Password to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: auth_realm
options.description: Keycloak realm name to authenticate to for API access.

options.name: auth_username
options.description: Username to authenticate for API access with.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The C(clientId) of the Keycloak client that should have the authorization scope. This is usually a human-readable name of the Keycloak client.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Controls the HTTP connections timeout period (in seconds) to Keycloak API.

options.name: display_name
options.description: The display name of the authorization scope.

options.name: icon_uri
options.description: The icon URI for the authorization scope.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the authorization scope to create.

options.name: realm
options.description: The name of the Keycloak realm the Keycloak client is in.

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Authentication refresh token for Keycloak API.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the authorization scope. On V(present), the authorization scope is created (or updated if it exists already). On V(absent), the authorization scope is removed if it exists.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Verify TLS certificates (do not disable this in production).
